evals.prompt: starting a youtube channel reviewing cheap gadgets under $50, honest no-sponsor vibe, a bit funny. need a name where the .com AND the youtube handle are free. keep it short pls
evals.expected_output: Ranked shortlist of short, varied names with .com and YouTube handle verified free, conflicts flagged, top pick.
assertions: Report lists at least 10 shortlisted names
Every shortlisted .com is unregistered when re-checked against the registry
Shortlisted names are short (most at or under 10 letters before .com)
Report includes a conflict check (existing brands/channels) for finalists
Report names a single top pick
Shortlist spans at least 3 naming styles (not just adjective+noun pairs)
YouTube handle availability was actually checked and reported for shortlisted names

assertions: Report lists at least 10 shortlisted names

Shortlisted names are short (most at or under 10 letters before .com)
Report includes a conflict check (existing brands/channels) for finalists
Report names a single top pick
Shortlist spans at least 3 naming styles (not just adjective+noun pairs)
.io and .ai availability reported for shortlisted names
No shortlisted name contains 'dent' or 'dental' (brief wants room to expand)
